description: A hidden gem in the heart of the 16th arrondissement: behind a discreet façade on Avenue d’Iéna, discover a 330 m² private mansion spread over three luminous floors with its five meters of ceiling height. Perfectly located between the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe, this timeless residence combines majestic volumes, soft light, and curated works of art. Every room inspires wonder. Enjoy rare tranquility, easy parking, and a dedicated concierge to take care of every detail.The spaceWelcome to an extraordinary place. Nestled on the prestigious Avenue d’Iéna, between the Eiffel Tower and the Arc de Triomphe, this 330 m² hôtel particulier unfolds its elegance across three light-filled floors.Imagined and designed by an artist, this home is a living work of art. Each space tells its own story, each bedroom unveils a unique world.The four suites, each with a distinct atmosphere, blend historic Parisian charm with a rare poetic sensibility. Vintage lines, timeless details, warm textures, and carefully chosen objects compose an interior that feels alive, inspiring, and deeply refined.The volumes are breathtaking: with 5-meter-high ceilings, natural light moves throughout the day across art-filled walls and refined architectural features.A double living room, both grand and inviting, welcomes guests for reflection or shared moments.The main dining room extends this intimate atmosphere, while a second dining space, more private, adjoins the kitchen below.Three elegantly designed bathrooms ensure privacy and comfort for all guests.An additional staff bedroom can be made available upon request (extra charge applies).For your convenience, the property is fully equipped (see full list of amenities).
